resources.string: Choose one image using Android’s picker. It is decoded locally, not uploaded or saved by GearBox. The preview is downsampled to at most 1,024 pixels per side and converted to sRGB; transparency is composited on white. Animated images use their first frame. Samples come from this displayed preview, not the original full-resolution image or a physical color measurement. An applied RGB color can enter your normal color history if enabled. The image is discarded on rotation or leaving this screen.
